rationales.Alabama: Alabama's 9-2 body of work — LSU, Florida State, Texas A&M, South Carolina and Kentucky — outweighs narrow losses to Georgia and Tennessee.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with a head-to-head win over Miami and dominant wins over Wisconsin and SMU, its lone blemish a four-point road loss at BYU.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 10-1 with wins over Florida State, Clemson and Wake Forest, and its only loss came at Notre Dame by a touchdown.
rationales.Utah: Utah is 11-0 with road wins at Arizona, Cincinnati, Iowa State and TCU, though its schedule lacks a top-10 caliber victory.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 9-2 with a win over USC and a one-score loss to Ohio State, its other defeat a three-point road game at Washington.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon is 8-3 but owns the best wins in the Big Ten — Ohio State, USC and Boise State — against three narrow losses.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 9-2 with a home win over Alabama and road wins at Arkansas and Texas A&M, with losses to Texas and South Carolina by a combined six points.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 10-1 with road wins at Oklahoma State, Baylor and Colorado, its only loss a road upset at Cincinnati.
rationales.BYU: BYU is 9-2 with a head-to-head win over Notre Dame plus Arizona and Iowa State, offset by losses to Utah and UCF.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 10-1 with six road-or-neutral wins including Louisville, SMU and Georgia Tech, its only loss to Miami.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia's 9-1 record, 23.9-point FBS margin and wins over Alabama, Oklahoma, Florida and Ole Miss give it the strongest on-field case.
rationales.Texas: Texas went 9-2 with a 15.1-point margin and quality wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, LSU and Ole Miss, despite narrow losses to Oklahoma and Florida.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with a 25.3-point margin, eight one-score wins and a head-to-head victory over Miami, with only a BYU loss preventing a perfect résumé.
rationales.Miami: Miami's 9-1 record, 18.1-point margin and wins over Clemson, Wake Forest, Pittsburgh and Florida State make its sole loss to Notre Dame manageable.
rationales.Utah: Utah is undefeated at 11-0, has no losses, and pairs a 16.2-point margin with wins over BYU, Arizona, Houston and Cincinnati.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana's 8-2 Big Ten résumé includes wins over Michigan, Nebraska, Northwestern and USC, giving the conference's strongest candidate a credible strength-of-schedule case.
rationales.Ohio State: Ohio State remains elite at 7-4 with a 14.7-point margin and wins over Iowa and Indiana, though losses to Oregon, USC, Nebraska and Texas prevent a top-five case.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon's 7-3 record includes a 41-28 road win over Ohio State and a 31-7 victory over Michigan, supporting a strong Big Ten schedule case despite three losses.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's 8-2 record and 16.9-point margin feature quality wins over Kentucky, South Carolina, LSU and Florida State, though losses to Georgia and Tennessee cost ground.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 10-1 with a 13.3-point margin, no one-score losses and wins over Houston, Arizona, Oklahoma State and Oregon State.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 8-2 with a 13.8-point margin and impressive wins over Alabama, Auburn, Kentucky and LSU, offset by narrow losses to Texas and South Carolina.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA's 10-1 Big Ten record, 16.5-point margin and wins over Oregon, Wisconsin, Illinois and Maryland make it a strong riser with only a narrow Michigan loss.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia's 9-1 FBS record, 23.9-point margin and wins over Alabama, Oklahoma, Florida, Ole Miss and Missouri give it the packet's strongest complete case.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with a 25.3-point margin, a neutral-site win over Wisconsin and a late 31-24 home win over Miami, with only a BYU loss.
rationales.Miami: Miami's 9-1 record, 18.1-point margin and wins over Clemson, Wake Forest, Florida State and Pittsburgh support an elite case despite its loss to Notre Dame.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, LSU and Ole Miss, while its Oklahoma loss and Florida defeat keep it below the leaders.
rationales.Utah: Utah is undefeated at 11-0 overall and 10-0 against FBS teams, with a 16.2-point margin and no notable losses in the packet.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana's 8-2 record, 13.6-point margin and road wins over Nebraska and Michigan justify the Big Ten's strongest playoff case.
rationales.Ohio State: Ohio State is 7-4 but owns wins over Iowa and Indiana and a 14.7-point margin, though losses to Oregon, USC, Nebraska and Texas limit its ceiling.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon's 7-3 record includes wins over Ohio State, USC, Nebraska and Michigan, giving it the best Big Ten schedule evidence despite three losses.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 10-1 overall and 9-1 against FBS teams, with a 13.3-point margin and only a Cincinnati loss among notable results.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with a 16.5-point margin and wins over Oregon, Wisconsin, Maryland and Michigan State, earning strong Big Ten consideration.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama is 8-2 with a 16.9-point margin and quality wins over Kentucky, South Carolina, LSU and Florida State, but losses to Georgia and Tennessee prevent a top-ten placement.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 8-2 with a 13.8-point margin and wins over Alabama, Auburn, Kentucky and LSU, though its Texas and South Carolina losses prevent a higher finish.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia is 10-1 with the packet's best scoring margin, a road win at Alabama, and wins over Oklahoma, Ole Miss, Missouri, and Florida; the lone Auburn loss is the only blemish on an elite body of work.
rationales.Utah: Utah is 11-0 with five road/neutral wins, beating BYU, Arizona, Houston, Iowa State, and TCU, though its schedule lacks a marquee top-10 victory, so I note some uncertainty about ceiling.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with a 25.3 mean margin, a head-to-head win over Miami, and wins over Wisconsin, SMU, and North Carolina; the only loss came at BYU.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 10-1 with a 24.4 SP-plus and wins over Clemson, Florida State, and Pittsburgh, with its only loss a one-score game at Notre Dame.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 10-1 with four road wins and wins over Houston, Arizona, and Oklahoma State; the lone loss at Cincinnati is its only real blemish, though its schedule is lighter than the teams above.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, LSU, and Ole Miss; the Oklahoma and Florida losses keep it out of the top five despite a very strong SEC slate.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama is 9-2 with wins over LSU, Florida State, Texas A&M, and South Carolina, but home losses to Georgia and at Tennessee cap its placement.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 9-2 with a win over USC and road wins at Nebraska and Michigan; losses to Ohio State and Washington are both narrow, and its metrics remain strong.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 9-2 with wins over Alabama, LSU, and Auburn; losses to Texas and South Carolina are both one-score games on a demanding SEC schedule.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 10-1 with six road/neutral wins, including Louisville, SMU, and Georgia Tech, but a 0.43 schedule proxy and a loss to Miami temper the resume.
rationales.BYU: BYU is 9-2 with a head-to-head win over Notre Dame plus Arizona and Iowa State, but losses to Utah and UCF leave it just outside the top ten.
rationales.Boise State: Boise State is 9-2 with four road wins including Fresno State and Colorado State; the Oregon loss is respectable, but the home San Diego State loss is a clear negative.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia owns the best collection of direct wins among candidates, beating Alabama, Oklahoma, Florida, Ole Miss, Missouri and South Carolina, with only a one-score loss to Auburn.
rationales.Texas: Texas beat Ohio State, Tennessee, Ole Miss, Missouri and LSU head-to-head, and its two losses to Oklahoma and Florida are narrow enough that the direct wins over elite competition carry the resume.
rationales.Miami: Miami's only loss is at Notre Dame, and its road win at Wake Forest plus a 41-13 win at Clemson and a 9-1 FBS mark make it the strongest ACC case.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame beat Miami head-to-head and has a 10-1 FBS record with a 25.3 average margin; its lone loss at BYU is the resume's main blemish.
rationales.Utah: Utah is 10-0 in FBS play and swept its direct games against BYU, Houston and Arizona, so the head-to-head results reinforce rather than undercut an unbeaten profile.
rationales.BYU: BYU beat Notre Dame and Arizona head-to-head, and its two losses came on the road at Utah and UCF, giving it the strongest two-loss case in the Big 12.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 in FBS play with direct wins over Houston and Arizona and a road win at Oklahoma State; the lone loss at Cincinnati is the main drag.
rationales.Ole Miss: Ole Miss beat Louisville and Missouri head-to-head, but losses to Georgia, Texas, Oklahoma and Florida keep it behind the one-loss and two-loss teams above.
rationales.Oklahoma: Oklahoma beat Texas head-to-head and also beat Florida and Ole Miss, but four losses, including home defeats to Kentucky and South Carolina, cap its case.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama beat Kentucky and South Carolina head-to-head, but the home loss to Georgia and the road loss to Tennessee are direct results that outweigh its strong wins.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee beat Alabama head-to-head and has a 9-2 record, but the loss at South Carolina and the home loss to Texas keep it behind the teams it split with.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana beat USC head-to-head and its only FBS losses are to Ohio State and Washington, but the head-to-head loss to Ohio State is the decisive comparison with the Buckeyes.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia dominates on the field with a +23.9 FBS scoring margin, highlighted by a 20-17 road win at Alabama and crushing blowouts of Oklahoma and Ole Miss.
rationales.Utah: Utah remains undefeated at 11-0 with emphatic physical play, beating BYU by eight and winning on the road at Arizona and TCU.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's dominant +25.3 average point margin and 31-24 victory over Miami cement their elite on-field profile.
rationales.Miami: Miami controls opponents with an 18.1-point margin, including a 13-point road win at Wake Forest and a 28-point blowout at Clemson.
rationales.Texas: Texas possesses a high-octane resume with physical road wins at Tennessee and Missouri alongside a signature victory over Ohio State.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana looks exceptionally sharp in Big Ten action with a 27-13 complete control win over USC and disciplined defense throughout.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA proved their mettle with a gritty 17-15 road upset over Oregon and owns a stellar +16.5 FBS point differential.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee showcases explosive power with a 26-10 dominant home victory over Alabama and a physical 34-6 rout of Kentucky.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama overwhelms opponents to a +16.9 scoring margin, backed by road blowouts at LSU and Kentucky despite two tight SEC road defeats.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest lights up the scoreboard with an average margin of +23.3, featuring dominant road blowouts over SMU and Georgia Tech.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech possesses an explosive offense generating a +13.3 margin with high-quality wins over Houston and Arizona.
rationales.BYU: BYU carries a heavyweight home triumph against Notre Dame and an 8-2 FBS mark, showing resilience in tight contests.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia's 9-1 record includes a 20-17 road win at Alabama and blowout wins over Oklahoma, Florida and South Carolina, the most dominant profile in the packet.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with a 25.3 average FBS margin and wins at Miami and over Stanford 58-7, with its only loss a narrow 24-28 road defeat at BYU.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with the signature 24-23 home win over Ohio State and a 34-27 win over Ole Miss, though close losses to Oklahoma and Florida temper it.
rationales.Ohio State: Ohio State is 7-4 and has the most damaging loss profile here, but it beat Texas-level competition narrowly and its wins over Kent State and Ball State were lopsided.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama is 9-2 with a 56-23 road rout of Mississippi State and a 26-10 win over Tennessee, offset by a 17-45 home loss to Georgia-level pressure from Kentucky's conference.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 10-1 with a 52-3 win over Central Michigan and a 52-23 rout of Pittsburgh, with a single narrow loss to Notre Dame.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon is 8-3 with a 41-28 road win at Ohio State and 41-27 win at USC, but a 15-17 home loss to UCLA and a 10-21 road loss to Illinois keep it below the top tier.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 9-2 with the 19-15 win at Ohio State and a 27-13 win over USC; its margin profile is strong with a 13.6 average FBS margin.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with a 17-15 road win at Oregon and a 54-3 rout of Maryland, its lone loss a 16-18 road game at Michigan.
rationales.Utah: Utah is 11-0 with a 40-39 road win at Arizona and a 28-20 home win over BYU, though its margins are closer than its record suggests.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 10-1 with a 52-27 win at Oklahoma State and a 53-25 home rout of Arizona State, with only a 24-37 road loss at Cincinnati.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 9-2 with a 26-10 home win over Alabama and a 34-6 win over Kentucky, offset by a 17-20 home loss to Texas.

rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 in FBS, with wins over Clemson, Wake Forest, and Florida State; its loss came on the road to Notre Dame.

rationales.Texas: Texas's 9-2 mark includes wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, Ole Miss, and Missouri, though losses to Oklahoma and Florida keep it below the top four.

rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest's 9-1 FBS record features road wins over Louisville, SMU, and NC State, with its only loss to Miami.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 in FBS with wins over Arizona, Houston, and Oklahoma State, though a road loss to Cincinnati is a significant blemish.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee's wins over Alabama and LSU strengthen its 8-2 record, balanced against defeats to Texas and South Carolina.
rationales.BYU: BYU's wins over Notre Dame, Arizona, and Iowa State are impressive, but losses to Utah and UCF leave it behind the stronger one-loss profiles.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama has a deep slate of wins, including LSU and Texas A&M, but losses to Georgia and Tennessee limit its placement.

rationales.BYU: BYU is 9-2 with a signature win over Notre Dame plus Arizona and Arizona State, offset by losses to Utah and UCF.
rationales.Iowa: Iowa is 9-2 with road wins at Michigan, Washington and Illinois plus a shutout of Wisconsin; its losses were to Ohio State and one-score at Minnesota.
rationales.Boise State: Boise State is 9-2 with wins over Memphis, Oregon State, Texas State and Fresno State; its losses were a close game at Oregon and a one-score home upset by San Diego State.

rationales.Utah: Utah is unbeaten at 10-0 against FBS teams, owns wins over BYU and Arizona, and rates strongly in SP+ and FPI despite a less demanding SOS proxy than the leaders.
rationales.Miami: Miami’s 9-1 record, 18.1-point average margin, 24.4 SP+ and 24.282 FPI are backed by wins over Clemson and Florida State, with its only loss at Notre Dame.

rationales.Texas: Texas has a 9-2 record, strong FPI and SP+, and wins over Ohio State, Tennessee and Ole Miss; the close Oklahoma and Florida losses temper that case.

rationales.UCLA: UCLA’s 10-1 record and 21.1 SP+ merit a high position, especially with a road win over Oregon, while its lower SOS proxy and loss at Michigan hold it below the leading one-loss teams.

rationales.Oregon: Oregon's SP+ of 18.3 and FPI of 21.3 rest on a 0.609 schedule proxy and a win over Ohio State, offset by losses to Oklahoma State and Illinois.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 10-1 with a 13.3 mean margin and FPI 17.1, with road wins at Oklahoma State and Oregon State, but its only loss is at Cincinnati.

rationales.Indiana: Indiana's 8-2 record, 13.6-point margin and wins over USC, Nebraska and Michigan support a strong Big Ten case despite losses to Ohio State and Washington.
rationales.Utah: Utah is undefeated at 10-0 with a 16.2-point margin, zero losses and wins over BYU, Houston and Arizona that make its case unusually clean.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 8-2 with a 13.8-point margin and wins over Alabama, Auburn, Kentucky and LSU, while its close losses to Texas and South Carolina temper the case.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama is 8-2 with a 16.9-point margin and wins over Kentucky, South Carolina, LSU and Florida State, though losses to Georgia and Tennessee matter.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with a 16.5-point margin and eight notable wins, including Oregon, Wisconsin, Maryland and Michigan State, giving it a strong Big Ten résumé.
rationales.Iowa: Iowa's 8-2 record, 12.3-point margin and wins over Michigan, Wisconsin, Northwestern and Illinois justify Big Ten benefit of the doubt despite its Ohio State loss.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia's only blemish is a one-point home loss to Auburn, offset by road wins at Alabama, Ole Miss and South Carolina plus neutral Florida — the strongest body of work in the packet, though I acknowledge some uncertainty at the very top.
rationales.Utah: Utah is 11-0 with no losses, wins over BYU, Arizona, Houston, Iowa State and TCU, and zero one-score losses; the schedule is lighter than Georgia's, so I place the Utes second.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 10-1 with its only loss a competitive road game at Notre Dame, plus wins over Clemson, Florida State and Pittsburgh; the head-to-head loss keeps the Hurricanes behind the Irish.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1, losing only by four at BYU while beating Miami, Wisconsin and SMU; its resume edges Miami's on common-opponent strength despite the Miami win.
rationales.BYU: BYU beat Notre Dame head-to-head and owns wins over Arizona, Arizona State and Kansas State, but losses to Utah and UCF leave the Cougars just behind the Irish.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with a win over Ohio State and road wins at Tennessee and LSU; the Oklahoma and Florida losses are damaging but the top-end wins are elite.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 10-1 with its only loss at Cincinnati, and wins over Houston, Arizona and Oklahoma State; the schedule is softer than Texas's, keeping the Red Raiders seventh.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 10-1 with six road/neutral wins, beating Louisville, SMU and Georgia Tech, losing only to Miami; the ACC slate justifies a top-10 slot despite modest metrics.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 in the Big Ten, winning at Oregon and beating Wisconsin, Illinois and Michigan State; the narrow loss at Michigan is the lone blemish.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 9-2 with a home win over USC and road wins at Nebraska and Michigan, losing close games to Ohio State and Washington.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama is 9-2 with wins over LSU, Florida State, Texas A&M and South Carolina, but home losses to Georgia and at Tennessee cap its ceiling.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 9-2 with wins over Alabama, LSU and Auburn, but losses to Texas and South Carolina and a weaker top-end profile place the Vols behind Alabama on common opponents.

rationales.Utah: Utah is 10-0 against FBS with wins over BYU, Arizona, and Houston, and the head-to-head win over BYU outweighs Notre Dame's stronger margin profile.
rationales.Miami: Miami's lone loss came at Notre Dame, but the Hurricanes' wins over Wake Forest, Clemson, and Duke plus a 9-1 FBS mark give them the strongest ACC case.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame beat Miami head-to-head and owns a 10-1 FBS record, but the loss at BYU keeps the Irish behind the unbeaten Utes and the Canes' deeper ACC slate.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 against FBS, beat Houston and Arizona head-to-head, and its only loss is on the road at Cincinnati.
rationales.Georgia: Georgia is 9-1 against FBS and has beaten Alabama, Oklahoma, Florida, Ole Miss, Missouri, and South Carolina; the Auburn loss is the lone blemish.
rationales.Texas: Texas beat Ohio State, Tennessee, Ole Miss, and Missouri, and its two losses are by a combined six points to Oklahoma and Florida.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana's only FBS losses are to Ohio State by four and Washington by three, and the head-to-head win over USC anchors a strong Big Ten resume.
rationales.Ole Miss: Ole Miss beat Louisville and Missouri and lost to Georgia, Texas, Oklahoma, and Florida; the Georgia and Texas losses are the ones that cap the ceiling.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 against FBS with a road win at Oregon, and the only loss is by two at Michigan.
rationales.BYU: BYU beat Notre Dame and Arizona head-to-head, and its two losses are on the road at Utah and UCF.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon beat Ohio State and USC head-to-head, but the home loss to UCLA and the road loss to Oklahoma State keep the Ducks below the Bruins.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 9-1 against FBS with a road win at Louisville, but the home loss to Miami is the direct result that separates the two.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia dominates on both sides of the ball with a +23.9 FBS scoring margin and emphatic blowout wins over top competition.
rationales.Utah: Utah is a flawless 11-0 with strong control in tough environments and a clean sweep of its candidate opponents.
rationales.Texas: Texas pairs marquee wins over Ohio State and Tennessee with decisive control in almost every matchup.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's dominant +25.3 average point differential and neutral-site beatdowns show an exceptionally complete team.
rationales.Miami: Miami showcases an explosive offense and convincing separation against top-flight conference opponents.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA proved its ceiling by going into Autzen and beating Oregon while suffocating most opponents defensively.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana plays sharp, efficient football, claiming quality wins over USC and Michigan while remaining highly consistent.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's blistering +16.9 margin and demolition of SEC contenders highlight its elite peak when clicking.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest looks electric offensively, racking up blowout victories and a stellar +23.3 FBS scoring margin.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee owns a physical, dominant win over Alabama and dictates tempo with a stout defensive front.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech boasts complete command in the Big 12, featuring a potent offense that wins convincingly by double digits.
rationales.BYU: BYU possesses great resilience and key top-tier wins over Notre Dame and Arizona on its resume.

rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's 25-point average margin over FBS foes and a 41-7 rout of Boston College show dominance, with BYU's 28-24 road escape the lone blemish.
rationales.Georgia: Georgia's 42-7 thumping of Ole Miss and 48-21 win over Missouri reveal a team that wins by margins, with only a one-point loss to Auburn.
rationales.Ohio State: Ohio State's 28-41 loss at home to Oregon and 24-23 narrow edge over Texas keep it below the top two despite its high talent profile.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana has blown out Rutgers 47-15 and Western Kentucky, while closing games like Ohio State 15-19 and Minnesota 23-16 at home.
rationales.Texas: Texas's 27-24 win over Florida and 34-27 win over Ole Miss were close, but it dominated Missouri 34-20 and beat Tennessee on the road.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's 49-18 blowout of South Carolina and 31-20 win over Texas A&M offset a 17-20 home loss to Georgia and a 10-26 loss to Tennessee.
rationales.Miami: Miami has won by margin nearly every week, with a 52-3 demolition of Central Michigan and a 52-23 rout of Pittsburgh.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon's 41-27 win at USC and 41-28 win at Ohio State are good road results, though a 15-17 home loss to UCLA and a 31-39 loss to Oklahoma State temper the picture.
rationales.Utah: Utah is undefeated with a 40-39 road win at Arizona and a 28-20 win over BYU, though its margins are mostly modest.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA's 17-7 win over Wisconsin and 54-3 rout of Maryland are strong, but a 16-18 loss to Michigan and a narrow 15-17 win over Oregon raise questions.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech has beaten Houston 28-26, Arizona 34-26, and Oklahoma State 52-27, with a 53-25 rout of Arizona State.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee's 26-10 win over Alabama and 27-24 win at South Carolina balance a 6-34 loss at Kentucky, which keeps it in the back half of the top 12.

rationales.Utah: Utah is unbeaten at 10-0 against FBS opponents, with wins over BYU, Arizona and Iowa State and no losses to offset that body of work.
rationales.Georgia: Georgia's 9-1 FBS record, decisive wins over Alabama, Oklahoma and Ole Miss, and only loss to Auburn narrowly place it behind Utah.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's 10-1 record features wins over Miami, Wisconsin and SMU; its four-point BYU loss is a meaningful blemish but not enough to erase the resume.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 with a strong schedule and wins over Clemson, Wake Forest and Florida State, while Notre Dame handed it its only defeat.
rationales.Texas: Texas owns wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, Ole Miss and Missouri, though narrow losses to Oklahoma and Florida keep it below the top four.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana has an 8-2 FBS record and wins over USC, Michigan and Nebraska; its close loss to Ohio State and late Washington defeat temper the case.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon's three losses include a road win over Ohio State and a win over USC, but its home defeats to UCLA and Illinois limit its ceiling.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee's wins over Alabama, LSU and Texas A&M are substantial, with its loss to Texas and defeat at South Carolina keeping it outside the top tier.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest has one loss, head-to-head over Louisville, and a dominant 49-7 win at SMU, though its schedule profile is less demanding than those above.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with wins over Houston, Arizona and Oklahoma State; the road loss to Cincinnati is the key blemish.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's eight FBS wins include LSU, Texas A&M and Florida State, but losses to Georgia and Tennessee make a higher placement difficult.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA's 10-1 record and road win at Oregon stand out; its only loss was a narrow road result at Michigan, although its schedule strength is comparatively modest.

rationales.Utah: With no AP poll supplied, resumes anchor this ranking: Utah is 11-0 with a 28-20 win over BYU, a 40-39 win at Arizona, and four one-score wins, making it the only unbeaten candidate.
rationales.Georgia: Georgia is 10-1 with the best scoring margin in the field and wins over Alabama, Ole Miss, Florida, Oklahoma, and Missouri, its only loss a one-score home upset by Auburn.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with a 31-24 win over Miami, a neutral win over Wisconsin, and a 24-3 win over SMU, its lone loss a one-score road game at BYU.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 10-1 with a 41-13 win at Clemson, a 43-35 win over Florida State, and a 52-23 rout of Pittsburgh, its only loss a one-score game at Notre Dame.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, LSU, Ole Miss, and Missouri, and both losses (Oklahoma, Florida) came by one score.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 10-1 with a 34-26 win over Arizona, a 53-25 rout of Arizona State, and road wins at Oklahoma State and Baylor, its only loss a 37-24 road upset by Cincinnati.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 10-1 with a 30-27 win at Louisville, a 49-7 rout of SMU, and six road-or-neutral wins, its only loss a home game against Miami.
rationales.Ohio State: Ohio State is just 7-4, but the losses were all one-score games against Texas, USC, Oregon, and Nebraska, and its wins include Iowa, Indiana, and Illinois.
rationales.BYU: BYU is 9-2 with a 28-24 win over Notre Dame, a 28-17 win over Arizona, and a road win at Kansas State, losing only at Utah and at UCF.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama is 9-2 with road wins at LSU, Kentucky, and Vanderbilt plus a 49-18 win over South Carolina, its losses a one-score home game to Georgia and a 26-10 loss at Tennessee.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 9-2 with a 27-13 win over USC and road wins at Nebraska and Michigan, its losses a one-score home game to Ohio State and a three-point loss at Washington.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 9-2 with a 26-10 home win over Alabama, a 27-13 win over LSU, and a road win at Texas A&M, losing one-score games to Texas and South Carolina.

rationales.Utah: Utah is unbeaten at 10-0 against FBS teams, with wins over BYU, Arizona, and Houston and no losses.
rationales.Georgia: Georgia's 9-1 FBS record and decisive wins over Alabama, Oklahoma, Ole Miss, and Missouri outweigh its lone defeat at Auburn.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame stands 10-1, with a strong win over Miami and a neutral-site victory over Wisconsin; its only loss was a four-point road defeat at BYU.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 against FBS teams, has beaten Clemson and Florida State on the road, and its only loss came at Notre Dame.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest's 9-1 mark features a 49-7 road win at SMU and a win at Louisville, with its sole defeat against Miami.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon's wins over Ohio State and USC, plus its narrow road win over Nebraska, support its 7-3 record despite losses to UCLA, Illinois, and Oklahoma State.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, Ole Miss, and LSU, though its head-to-head loss to Oklahoma and defeat to Florida hold it below the top six.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana's 8-2 record includes wins over USC, Michigan, and Nebraska, while its narrow loss to Ohio State and recent road loss at Washington temper the résumé.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 and has beaten Arizona and Houston, but the road loss at Cincinnati keeps it below the stronger one-loss contenders.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee's 8-2 record includes a 26-10 win over Alabama and wins over LSU and Texas A&M; its losses to Texas and South Carolina are both close.
rationales.BYU: BYU has quality wins over Notre Dame, Arizona, and Iowa State, but its losses to Utah and UCF make it a step behind the top ten.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA's 10-1 record and road win over Oregon are compelling, though its schedule-strength proxy is modest and it lost at Michigan.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia’s 9-1 FBS record, 23.9-point average margin, leading FPI/SP+ ratings, and wins over Alabama and several ranked opponents outweigh its lone loss to Auburn.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame combines a 10-1 record, 25.3-point average margin, elite FPI/SP+, and a head-to-head win over Miami, with its only loss coming by four at BYU.
rationales.Miami: Miami’s 9-1 record, 18.1-point average margin, strong ratings, and wins over Clemson and Wake Forest make a compelling resume, though Notre Dame beat it head-to-head.
rationales.Utah: Undefeated Utah has a 10-0 FBS record, four ranked-opponent wins, and head-to-head victories over BYU and Arizona; its SP+ and FPI also support a top-four seed.
rationales.Texas: Texas owns a 9-2 record and strong SOS, with wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, Ole Miss, and Missouri, while two narrow losses and its neutral-site loss to Oklahoma temper the case.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana’s 8-2 record and top-tier ratings include wins over USC, Michigan, and Nebraska; its four-point home loss to Ohio State and road loss at Washington are the blemishes.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon’s strong SOS, FPI/SP+, and wins over Ohio State, USC, and Boise State are offset by three losses, including defeats to UCLA and Illinois.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest’s 9-1 record, 23.3-point average margin, and strong efficiency ratings merit a high ranking, but the home loss to Miami and lower SOS restrain it.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama has high-end FPI/SP+ and an 8-2 record with wins over LSU and Texas A&M, but losses to Georgia and Tennessee prevent a top-eight placement.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee’s 8-2 record, 13.8-point margin, and wins over Alabama and LSU are strong, while losses to Texas and South Carolina and a lower SOS than leading contenders hold it back.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA’s 10-1 record and 21.1 SP+ are impressive, and its road win over Oregon is a top result; its lighter SOS and loss at Michigan count against it.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with no one-score losses and wins over Houston, Arizona, and Oklahoma State, but its lower SOS and ratings than the leading one-loss teams limit its ceiling.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia leads the packet on SP+ (31.3) and FPI (28.7), with a 9-1 FBS record, a 23.9 mean FBS margin, and a 42-7 road win at Ole Miss.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with the best FBS margin among top contenders (25.3), a 58-7 win over Stanford, and a 24-28 road loss at BYU as its only blemish.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 in FBS play with an 18.1 mean margin, a 43-35 home win over Florida State, and a 31-24 loss at Notre Dame as its only defeat.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with a 15.1 mean margin, a 24-23 home win over Ohio State and a 20-17 road win at Tennessee, offset by losses to Oklahoma and Florida.
rationales.Utah: Utah is unbeaten at 11-0 with a 16.2 mean margin and wins over BYU, Houston, and Arizona, though its schedule proxy (0.48) and SP+ (21.7) trail the top tier.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama is 9-2 with a 16.9 mean margin and a 17-20 home loss to Georgia, but its 26-10 home loss to Tennessee and SP+ of 22.9 keep it right in the mix.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 9-2 with a 13.8 mean margin and a 10-26 loss at Alabama, with road wins at Texas and Texas A&M and a 27-24 win over South Carolina.
rationales.Ohio State: Ohio State is 7-4 by record, but SP+ (24.1) and FPI (23.2) rate it near the top, with a 30-18 home loss to USC and a 14-31 loss to Iowa offset by wins over Iowa and Indiana.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 9-2 with a 13.6 mean margin, a 27-13 home win over USC, and a 19-15 road win over Ohio State, though a 24-27 loss to Washington is a blemish.
rationales.Iowa: Iowa is 9-2 with a 12.3 mean margin and a 31-14 road win over Ohio State offset by a 14-31 home loss to Ohio State and a 10-13 loss to Minnesota.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 10-1 with a 23.3 mean margin and a 30-27 road win at Louisville, but its only loss is a 20-33 home defeat to Miami and its SOS proxy (0.43) is modest.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 10-1 with a 13.3 mean margin and road wins at Oklahoma State and Oregon State, with its only defeat a 24-37 loss at Cincinnati.

rationales.Utah: Undefeated record combined with head-to-head victories over BYU and Arizona secures the top seed.
rationales.Georgia: A dominant SEC resume with top-tier wins over Alabama and Oklahoma earns the second bye.
rationales.Notre Dame: Secured the third seed with a decisive 31-24 head-to-head victory over Miami.
rationales.Miami: Boasts a commanding 33-20 head-to-head win over Wake Forest to cement the final bye.
rationales.Texas: Holds the critical 20-17 road head-to-head victory over Tennessee to lead the two-loss pack.
rationales.Tennessee: Claims a high seed on the strength of a 26-10 head-to-head triumph over Alabama.
rationales.Alabama: Head-to-head dominance over Kentucky and South Carolina keeps the Tide solidly in the top eight.
rationales.Wake Forest: Defeated Louisville head-to-head 30-27 and carries only one loss to top-ranked Miami.
rationales.Texas Tech: Carries a sparkling 10-1 record bolstered by head-to-head wins against Arizona and Houston.
rationales.UCLA: Direct 17-15 head-to-head road victory over Oregon gives the Bruins a strong playoff profile.
rationales.BYU: Holds direct head-to-head wins over Notre Dame and Arizona to validate an elite resume.
rationales.Indiana: Boasts a 27-13 head-to-head victory over USC to claim the final playoff spot.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia owns the packet's best win set, beating Alabama away, Oklahoma, Florida, Ole Miss, Missouri and South Carolina, with only a 24-27 home loss to Auburn.
rationales.Texas: Texas beat Ohio State, Tennessee away, Ole Miss, Missouri away and LSU away; the Oklahoma neutral loss and Florida home loss are offset by that road-win volume.
rationales.Utah: Utah is 10-0 in FBS play with wins over BYU, Houston, Arizona away, Cincinnati away, Iowa State away and TCU away, so the unbeaten record carries real substance.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's only loss is at BYU, and the Irish answered with a home win over Miami plus a 25.3-point average FBS margin.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 in FBS with a road win at Wake Forest and a 41-13 win at Clemson; the lone loss is at Notre Dame.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama beat Kentucky away, South Carolina, LSU away, Texas A&M and Vanderbilt away; the Georgia home loss and Tennessee road loss are the only blemishes.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee beat Alabama 26-10, Kentucky, LSU, Auburn and Texas A&M away, with narrow losses to Texas and at South Carolina.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 in FBS with wins over Houston, Arizona, Oklahoma State away, Baylor away and Colorado away; the Cincinnati road loss is the only defeat.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with a road win at Oregon, plus Wisconsin, Illinois, Minnesota away and Maryland away; the only loss is 16-18 at Michigan.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana beat USC and Nebraska away and Michigan away, with losses only to Ohio State by four and at Washington by three.
rationales.BYU: BYU beat Notre Dame and Arizona at home and won at TCU and Kansas; the Utah road loss and UCF road loss keep it below the one-loss leaders.
rationales.Ole Miss: Ole Miss beat Louisville neutral, Missouri, LSU and Auburn, but the 7-42 home loss to Georgia and the Florida road loss weigh heavily.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia is 10-1 with road wins over Alabama, Ole Miss and South Carolina plus neutral-site handling of Florida, and the lone Auburn loss doesn't offset the SEC's deepest body of work.
rationales.Utah: Utah is 11-0 with five road/neutral wins including BYU, Arizona and Iowa State, and the packet shows zero losses.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 10-1 with a ranked win over Wake Forest and road wins at Clemson and Florida State, losing only at Notre Dame.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 10-1 with its only loss at Cincinnati and quality wins over Houston, Arizona and Oklahoma State.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with a head-to-head win over Miami and a dominant resume, with the only blemish a one-score loss at BYU.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 in the SEC with wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, Ole Miss, Missouri and LSU, and both losses came by one score.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 10-1 with six road/neutral wins including Louisville and SMU, its only loss a one-score home game against Miami.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama is 9-2 with wins over LSU, Florida State, Texas A&M and South Carolina, and both losses (Georgia, Tennessee) came by one score against top-10 opponents.
rationales.BYU: BYU is 9-2 with a head-to-head win over Notre Dame plus Arizona, Arizona State and TCU, with losses to Utah and UCF.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 9-2 with a home win over Alabama and road wins at Arkansas and Texas A&M, with one-score losses to Texas and South Carolina.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 9-2 with a win over USC and road wins at Nebraska and Michigan, with narrow losses to Ohio State and Washington.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with a road win over Oregon and wins over Wisconsin, Illinois and Minnesota, with the lone loss a two-point game at Michigan.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia remains the national benchmark at 9-1, with a 23.9-point FBS margin and wins over Alabama, Oklahoma, Florida, Ole Miss, Missouri and South Carolina.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's 10-1 record, 25.3-point margin and decisive wins over Miami, Wisconsin, Stanford and Boston College outweigh its narrow BYU loss.
rationales.Miami: Miami's 9-1 body of work includes a 33-20 win over Wake Forest and a 41-13 road win over Clemson, with only a close loss to Notre Dame.
rationales.Utah: Utah is 11-0 with no losses, five road or neutral wins and quality victories over BYU, Arizona, Cincinnati and Houston.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with a 15.1-point margin and wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, Ole Miss, Missouri and LSU, though losses to Oklahoma and Florida prevent perfection.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana's 8-2 record, 13.6-point margin and road wins over Nebraska and Michigan support a strong Big Ten case despite losses to Ohio State and Washington.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon's 8-3 record includes a 41-28 road win over Ohio State and a 41-27 win over USC, giving it the best schedule strength among the Big Ten candidates.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 10-1 with zero one-score losses, a 13.3-point margin and wins over Houston, Arizona, Oklahoma State and Oregon State.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with a 16.5-point margin, six road or neutral wins and a head-to-head win over Oregon that strengthens its Big Ten case.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 8-2 with a 13.8-point margin and quality wins over Alabama, Auburn, Kentucky, LSU and Texas A&M despite narrow losses to Texas and South Carolina.
rationales.Ohio State: Ohio State is 7-4 with a 14.7-point margin and wins over Iowa, Indiana, Illinois and Northwestern, but losses to Oregon, USC, Nebraska and Texas keep it below the leaders.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 9-1 with a 23.3-point margin and six road or neutral wins, including a 49-7 win over SMU, with only a loss to Miami.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia combines a 9-1 FBS record, 23.9-point margin and wins over Alabama, Florida, Ole Miss, Missouri and South Carolina, with only an Auburn loss.
rationales.Utah: Utah is 11-0 overall, 10-0 against FBS and unbeaten with a 16.2-point margin, including wins over BYU, Houston and Arizona.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's 10-1 FBS record and 25.3-point margin are strengthened by a win over Miami and a neutral-site victory over Wisconsin.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 against FBS with a 15.1-point margin and quality wins over Tennessee, Ohio State, Ole Miss, Missouri and LSU.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana's 8-2 FBS record, 13.6-point margin and wins over USC, Nebraska, Michigan and Northwestern justify a Big Ten benefit of the doubt.
rationales.Ohio State: Ohio State has a 14.7-point margin and wins over Iowa and Indiana, but losses to Oregon, USC, Nebraska and Texas cap its case.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon's 7-3 FBS record includes wins over Ohio State, USC, Michigan and Michigan State, though losses to UCLA, Illinois and Oklahoma State prevent a higher placement.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 against FBS with an 18.1-point margin and wins over Wake Forest, Clemson, Stanford and Pittsburgh, with only a narrow loss to Notre Dame.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 10-1 overall and 9-1 against FBS, with a 13.3-point margin and wins over Houston, Arizona, Oklahoma State and Oregon State.
rationales.Iowa: Iowa's 8-2 FBS record and 12.3-point margin include wins over Michigan, Wisconsin, Northwestern and Illinois, offset by losses to Ohio State and Minnesota.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 against FBS with a 16.5-point margin and wins over Oregon, Wisconsin, Illinois and Michigan State, giving it a strong Big Ten case.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 9-1 against FBS with a 23.3-point margin and wins over Louisville, SMU, Stanford and Virginia, with only a loss to Miami.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia's lone blemish is a one-score home loss to Auburn, offset by road wins over Alabama, Ole Miss and South Carolina plus neutral-site and home wins over Florida, Missouri and Oklahoma.
rationales.Utah: Utah is 11-0 with a perfect FBS record, including wins over BYU, Houston, Arizona, Iowa State, TCU and Arkansas, though several were close and I note residual uncertainty about margin quality.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's only loss is a one-score road game at BYU, and its home win over Miami provides the head-to-head edge for the ACC leader's slot beneath it.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 10-1 with the lone loss coming at Notre Dame, and quality wins over Wake Forest, Clemson and Florida State support a top-four bye case.
rationales.Texas: Texas has two one-score losses (Oklahoma, Florida) but a strong slate of wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, LSU, Ole Miss and Missouri on the nation's toughest schedules.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's losses to Georgia and Tennessee are outweighed by wins over LSU, Florida State, Texas A&M, South Carolina and Vanderbilt, though the 16-point Tennessee defeat gives pause.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 10-1 with its only loss a road stumble at Cincinnati, backed by wins over Houston, Arizona, Oklahoma State and Arizona State.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 10-1 with six road or neutral wins and a lone loss to Miami, including a 49-7 rout of SMU, though its schedule strength is the softest among the one-loss majors.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with a road win over Oregon and only a one-score loss at Michigan, a resume I weigh carefully given a comparatively lighter conference slate.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 9-2 with wins over Alabama, Auburn, LSU and Texas A&M, but losses to Texas and South Carolina keep it just outside the bye line.
rationales.BYU: BYU is 9-2 with a signature home win over Notre Dame and a win over Arizona, but losses to Utah and UCF temper its case.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 9-2 with narrow losses to Ohio State and Washington and a home win over USC, placing it just behind the two-loss Big 12 and SEC contenders ahead of Oregon, whose three losses include UCLA, Oklahoma State and Illinois.

rationales.Utah: Utah is 11-0 with wins over BYU, Houston, and Arizona, and no direct loss outweighs that unbeaten body of work.
rationales.Georgia: Georgia's only loss is to Auburn, and its head-to-head wins over Alabama, Oklahoma, Florida, Ole Miss, Missouri, and South Carolina anchor the No. 2 case.
rationales.Miami: Miami's lone loss came at Notre Dame, but its 10-1 record and road win at Wake Forest keep it ahead of the Irish on overall resume.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame beat Miami head-to-head, yet the BYU loss and weaker schedule strength leave the Irish just behind the Hurricanes.
rationales.Texas: Texas beat Ohio State, Tennessee, Ole Miss, and Missouri, but the head-to-head loss to Oklahoma and the Florida loss cap the Longhorns here.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 10-1 with head-to-head wins over Houston and Arizona, and its only loss is a road game at Cincinnati.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana's head-to-head loss to Ohio State is outweighed by a stronger overall resume, including wins over USC, Nebraska, and Michigan.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon beat Ohio State and USC head-to-head, but the home loss to UCLA and the Illinois loss keep the Ducks below Indiana.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with a head-to-head win at Oregon, and its only loss is a two-point road game at Michigan.
rationales.BYU: BYU beat Notre Dame and Arizona head-to-head, but the Utah loss and the UCF loss leave the Cougars behind the Bruins.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest lost head-to-head to Miami but beat Louisville, and its 10-1 record and road wins keep it ahead of Alabama.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's head-to-head losses to Georgia and Tennessee outweigh its wins over Kentucky and South Carolina, placing the Tide at No. 12.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia's dominant 23.9-point FBS margin and road wins at Alabama and Ole Miss showcase exceptional game control.
rationales.Utah: Utah remains unblemished at 11-0 with a stellar 43-10 thrashing of Arkansas and key wins over BYU and Houston.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame looks like an absolute juggernaut by blitzing opponents by an average of 25.3 points, including a signature victory over Miami.
rationales.Miami: Miami's high-powered offense produces an 18.1-point average margin with decisive road blowouts at Wake Forest and Clemson.
rationales.Texas: Texas boasts quality physical wins against Ohio State and at Tennessee alongside explosive blowout capability.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama shows elite visual dominance with an average margin of 16.9 points and a 31-13 dismantling of LSU in Baton Rouge.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee controls lines of scrimmage convincingly, underscored by a decisive 26-10 home victory over Alabama.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech passes the eye test with a 10-1 record, a +13.3 margin, and an emphatic 52-27 road rout of Oklahoma State.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest lights up the scoreboard with seven blowout victories and a tremendous +23.3 average scoring margin.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA has looked sharp in ten wins, highlighted by a gritty road victory over Oregon and stifling defensive consistency.
rationales.BYU: BYU demonstrates gritty winning form with ranked victories over Notre Dame and Arizona.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana plays sharp, clean football, boasting a +13.6 scoring margin and a comfortable two-touchdown win over USC.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia's 10-1 mark includes a dominant 42-7 road win at Ole Miss and a 48-21 home win over Missouri, with its lone loss a 24-27 home defeat to Auburn.
rationales.Miami: Miami's 9-1 body of work features a road win over Notre Dame's rival-level opponent and a 45-6 win at Stanford, though a 24-31 road loss at Notre Dame tempers its case.
rationales.Utah: Utah is unbeaten at 11-0, with road wins at Arizona (40-39) and Cincinnati (49-25) carrying its resume despite close margins.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with a 41-7 home win over Boston College and a 24-31 loss-free sequence except a close 28-24 home win over BYU that doesn't add much weight.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with a 27-24 win over Oklahoma and a 34-27 home win over Ole Miss, but its losses to Florida and Oklahoma were both single-score home-or-neutral setbacks.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama is 9-2 with a 49-18 win over South Carolina and a 31-13 win at LSU, but a 10-26 home loss to Tennessee and a 17-20 home loss to Georgia keep it below the top tier.
rationales.Ohio State: Ohio State is 7-4 with a 30-18 loss to USC and a 28-41 home loss to Oregon, but it did win 24-23 at Texas, keeping the profile competitive.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 9-2 with a 27-13 win over USC and a 19-15 road win at Ohio State, though its 24-27 loss at Washington is a meaningful blemish.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 9-2 with a 26-10 home win over Alabama, a 20-17 road win at Texas, and a 27-24 road win at South Carolina.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 10-1 with a 49-7 win at SMU and 57-3 home win over Stanford, though its 20-33 home loss to Miami is its only blemish.
rationales.BYU: BYU is 9-2 with a 28-17 win over Arizona and 28-24 win over Notre Dame, but its 20-28 road loss at Utah and 31-39 road loss to UCF limit its profile.
rationales.Boise State: Boise State is 9-2 with a road win at Oregon margin of only 7 points and wins over Oregon State and Texas State that were close, plus a 20-22 home loss to San Diego State.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia stays atop the AP order after beating Alabama, Florida, Ole Miss, and Missouri, with its only loss a narrow home defeat to Auburn.
rationales.Utah: Undefeated Utah moves ahead of Notre Dame: its wins over BYU and Arizona plus its perfect 10-0 FBS record outweigh Notre Dame's loss to BYU.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's strong win over Miami and 10-1 record keep it third, though BYU's head-to-head victory is a meaningful counterpoint.
rationales.Miami: Miami's only loss is at Notre Dame, and its wins over Wake Forest, Clemson, Florida State, and Duke sustain its high placement.
rationales.Texas: Texas retains a top-five spot on a 9-2 record and wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, Ole Miss, Missouri, and LSU, despite losses to Oklahoma and Florida.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon rises from No. 14 after road wins over Ohio State and USC and a win over Boise State; its UCLA and Illinois losses prevent a higher place.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana's wins over USC, Michigan, and Nebraska support a top-12 case, while its Ohio State loss and Washington defeat keep it below the top six.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee's 8-2 resume features wins over Alabama, LSU, and Kentucky, balanced by losses to Texas and South Carolina.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's wins over LSU, Texas A&M, and Florida State are substantial, but losses to Georgia and Tennessee leave it below the leading one-loss teams.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech has one loss, wins over Arizona, Houston, and Oklahoma State, and a winning record against ranked-reference opponents; Cincinnati is its lone setback.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest's 9-1 record and emphatic SMU win are strong, but its Miami loss and lighter schedule context leave it just outside the top ten.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA's 10-1 record and road win at Oregon stand out, although the schedule is less demanding and Michigan handed it its only defeat.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia stays No. 1: 10-1 with the lone loss a one-point home upset by Auburn, plus wins over Alabama, Oklahoma, Ole Miss, Missouri and Florida.
rationales.Utah: Utah is 11-0 with road wins at BYU, Arizona, Iowa State and TCU and a home win over Houston, the Big 12's best resume.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's only loss is a one-score road game at BYU, offset by wins over Miami, Wisconsin and SMU.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 10-1 with its only loss a one-score game at Notre Dame, and it beat Wake Forest, Clemson and Florida State.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, LSU and Ole Miss; its two losses (Oklahoma, Florida) were one-score games.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's 9-2 includes wins over LSU, Texas A&M, Florida State and South Carolina, with losses only to Georgia and Tennessee.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 9-2 with a home win over Alabama and losses only in one-score games to Texas and South Carolina.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 10-1 with six road wins and a 23.3 scoring margin; the lone loss was to Miami.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 10-1 with no other losses, wins over Houston, Arizona and Oklahoma State, and a lone stumble at Cincinnati.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with a road win over Oregon and a 16.5 scoring margin; the only loss was a two-point game at Michigan.
rationales.BYU: BYU is 9-2 with a home win over Notre Dame and Arizona, but losses to Utah and UCF keep it behind the one-loss teams.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 9-2 with a home win over USC and narrow losses to Ohio State and Washington; Iowa's 9-2 with a win at Michigan edges Oregon's 8-3 despite Oregon's wins over Ohio State and USC.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia is 9-1 against FBS teams, with wins over Alabama, Oklahoma, Florida, Ole Miss, and Missouri; its lone loss was a three-point home result against Auburn.
rationales.Utah: Utah is unbeaten at 10-0 against FBS opponents, with wins over BYU, Arizona, Houston, and Cincinnati, and its 40-39 road win over Arizona is a particularly strong result.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's 10-1 record features a win over Miami and a neutral-site win over Wisconsin, while its only loss was a four-point road defeat at BYU.
rationales.Miami: Miami's 9-1 mark includes road wins over Wake Forest and Clemson and a home win over Florida State; Notre Dame's head-to-head win puts the Irish ahead.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, Ole Miss, and Missouri, and its narrow losses to Oklahoma and Florida are balanced by a stronger schedule than most contenders.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon's three losses are offset by wins over Ohio State, USC, and Boise State; its Ohio State victory and 41-7 win over Michigan since the AP poll strengthen its case.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 8-2, with wins over USC, Michigan, and Nebraska; its four-point home loss to Ohio State and road loss at Washington keep it below the top six.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1, has no one-score losses, and owns wins over Arizona, Houston, and Oklahoma State, though the packet offers fewer marquee victories than the teams above it.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee's 8-2 record includes a win over Alabama and a 27-13 result over LSU since the poll, but losses to Texas and South Carolina prevent a higher placement.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 9-1 and has impressive road wins over Louisville and SMU, but Miami beat it head-to-head and the schedule-strength proxy is comparatively modest.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama has an 8-2 record and strong wins over LSU and Texas A&M, but losses to Georgia and Tennessee leave it behind teams with better records or stronger head-to-head evidence.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with a road win over Oregon and several convincing victories; I place it just behind Alabama because its schedule-strength proxy is lower, while Alabama's brand preference is only a modest tiebreaker.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia leads on SP+ (31.3), FPI (28.7), and a 23.9 scoring margin, with wins over Alabama, Oklahoma, Florida, and Missouri in the final stretch.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with SP+ 25.6 and FPI 27.2, and its one loss is a three-point road defeat to BYU.
rationales.Utah: Utah is unbeaten at 11-0 with a 16.2 scoring margin, though its SP+ (21.7) trails the top two and it has no ranked-opponent loss to weigh.
rationales.Ohio State: Ohio State's 7-4 record is weaker than its ratings (SP+ 24.1, FPI 23.2), but it has losses to Texas, USC, and Oregon, which limit its case.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with SP+ 22.4 and FPI 25.4 and has wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, Ole Miss, and Missouri, offset by losses to Oklahoma and Florida.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama is 9-2 with SP+ 22.9 and FPI 24.2, a 17-20 loss to Georgia, and a win over LSU, but it lost to Tennessee.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 with SP+ 24.4 and FPI 24.3, with one loss, to Notre Dame, and a solid 52-23 win over Pittsburgh.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 8-2 with SP+ 23.1 and FPI 20.8, but its best win is over USC and its only ranked loss is to Ohio State.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 8-2 with SP+ 21.5, a win over Alabama, and a loss to South Carolina, with a schedule that is mid-tier.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 9-1 with SP+ 22.6, a 23.3 scoring margin, and a single loss to Miami.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 with SP+ 19.4, an exceptional scoring profile, and quality wins over Arizona and Houston, but its only loss came at Cincinnati.
rationales.BYU: BYU is 8-2 with SP+ 18.0 and FPI 15.3, with a road win at Kansas and a home win over Notre Dame, offset by losses to Utah and UCF.

rationales.Utah: Utah is undefeated at 11-0 with direct head-to-head victories over BYU and Arizona.
rationales.Georgia: Georgia sits at 10-1 with a dominant resume, highlighted by head-to-head wins over Alabama and Oklahoma.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame claims the third spot on the strength of defeating Miami head-to-head 31-24.
rationales.Miami: Miami's lone defeat came against Notre Dame, bolstered by a direct 33-20 victory over Wake Forest.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest stands at 10-1 with its single loss coming against Miami and a quality road win over Louisville.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA boasts a 10-1 record featuring a key 17-15 head-to-head road triumph over Oregon.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech holds a strong 10-1 record with direct head-to-head victories against both Houston and Arizona.
rationales.Texas: Texas is positioned at 9-2 on the strength of its 20-17 head-to-head road victory over Tennessee.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee ranks ninth, holding a decisive 26-10 head-to-head victory over Alabama.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama follows Tennessee based on that direct loss, maintaining an exceptional resume and a victory over South Carolina.
rationales.BYU: BYU is 9-2 with a direct head-to-head win over Notre Dame, though falling behind due to losses against Utah and UCF.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana earns the final playoff seed at 9-2 with a decisive head-to-head victory over USC.

rationales.Utah: Utah is 10-0 in FBS play with wins over BYU, Houston, Arizona, Cincinnati, Iowa State and TCU, the deepest set of quality wins in the packet.
rationales.Georgia: Georgia's only loss is a 24-27 home result to Auburn, offset by road wins at Alabama and Ole Miss plus a neutral rout of Florida, giving the best combined quality-win profile.
rationales.Texas: Texas beat Ohio State, Tennessee on the road, Ole Miss and Missouri, with narrow losses to Oklahoma and Florida that keep it just behind Georgia's body of work.
rationales.Miami: Miami's lone loss came at Notre Dame, and road wins at Wake Forest and Clemson plus a 52-23 win over Pittsburgh anchor an ACC-best resume.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's only loss is at BYU, and the Irish answered with a home win over Miami and lopsided wins over SMU, North Carolina and Wisconsin.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's two losses are to Georgia by three and at Tennessee, and its road wins at LSU and Kentucky plus a home win over Texas A&M carry real SEC weight.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 in FBS with wins over Houston, Arizona, Oklahoma State and Baylor, its only blemish a road loss at Cincinnati.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with a road win at Oregon and a one-score loss at Michigan, plus wins over Wisconsin, Illinois and Minnesota.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest's only loss is at home to Miami, and its road wins at Louisville, NC State, SMU and Georgia Tech make a strong ACC case.
rationales.BYU: BYU beat Notre Dame and Arizona and won at Kansas, but the head-to-head road loss at Utah and the UCF loss cap the resume.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee's wins over Alabama, LSU and Auburn are strong, though the home loss to Texas and road loss at South Carolina weigh against it.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana's wins over USC, Nebraska and Michigan are solid, but the home loss to Ohio State and road loss at Washington keep it in the back of the top 12.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia's 10-1 body of work — road wins at Alabama, Ole Miss and South Carolina plus neutral wins over Florida and Oklahoma — is the packet's best, with the only blemish a one-point home loss to Auburn.
rationales.Utah: Utah is the packet's lone unbeaten at 11-0, with five road/neutral wins including BYU, Arizona, Houston and Iowa State, and no losses to weigh against it.
rationales.Texas: Texas's 9-2 SEC slate features a win over then-ranked Ohio State plus victories over Tennessee, Ole Miss, Missouri and LSU, with both losses by a field goal to Oklahoma and Florida.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's only losses are one-score defeats to Georgia and Tennessee, while its wins over LSU, Texas A&M, South Carolina, Kentucky and Florida State give the SEC's deepest quality-win list behind the top two.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 10-1 with its lone loss a one-score game at Notre Dame, and it owns wins over Wake Forest, Clemson and Florida State in a strong ACC profile.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's only loss is a four-point road game at BYU, offset by a head-to-head win over Miami and dominant wins over Wisconsin, SMU and Stanford.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee's 9-2 case rests on a home win over Alabama and road wins at Georgia Tech, Arkansas and Texas A&M, with one-score losses only to Texas and South Carolina.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 10-1 with its only loss at Cincinnati, and it beat Houston, Arizona, Oklahoma State and Arizona State in a strong Big 12 run.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 10-1 with six road/neutral wins, including Louisville, SMU and Georgia Tech, and its only loss was a one-score game against Miami.
rationales.BYU: BYU's 9-2 profile includes a home win over Notre Dame plus wins over Arizona, Iowa State and TCU, with losses only to Utah and UCF.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 9-2 with wins over USC, Michigan and Nebraska, and its two losses — Ohio State by four and Washington by three — are both one-score games.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with a marquee road win at Oregon and wins over Illinois, Minnesota and Wisconsin, its lone loss a two-point game at Michigan.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia remains the clear No. 1 after wins over Alabama, Florida, Ole Miss, Missouri and South Carolina, with a 23.9-point FBS margin and the packet's best FPI and SP+ marks.
rationales.Texas: Texas pairs a 9-2 record with wins over Tennessee, Ohio State, Ole Miss, Missouri and LSU, while its Oklahoma loss was on a neutral field and its only other defeat came against Florida.
rationales.Miami: Miami's 9-1 record, 18.1-point margin and road wins over Wake Forest, Clemson and Stanford support a top-four case despite its narrow home loss to Notre Dame.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with a 25.3-point margin, a win over Miami and a neutral-site victory over Wisconsin, although its loss to BYU prevents a claim to perfection.
rationales.Utah: Utah is undefeated at 11-0 with no losses, five road or neutral wins and a 40-39 road win over Arizona that materially strengthens its case.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana's 8-2 Big Ten résumé includes wins over USC, Nebraska, Michigan and Northwestern, and its 13.6-point margin earns a deserved benefit of the doubt.
rationales.Ohio State: Ohio State stays elite at 7-4 because of wins over Iowa, Indiana, Illinois and Northwestern, but losses to Oregon, USC, Nebraska and Texas prevent a top-five ranking.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon's 8-3 record includes a decisive 41-28 road win over Ohio State and a 45-7 win over Michigan State, though losses to UCLA, Illinois and Oklahoma State keep it below the leaders.
rationales.Iowa: Iowa's 8-2 finish features wins over Michigan, Washington, Wisconsin, Northwestern and Illinois, with the narrow Ohio State loss its only defeat to a ranked opponent.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with a 16.5-point margin, a road win over Oregon and a dominant 54-3 road win over Maryland, making it a stronger résumé than its No. 10 AP position suggests.
rationales.USC: USC's 8-3 case includes a 30-18 home win over Ohio State, but losses to Oregon, Wisconsin and Indiana keep the Big Ten's other leading team below the top ten.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's 8-2 résumé includes wins over Kentucky, South Carolina, LSU, Florida State and Mississippi State, though losses to Georgia and Tennessee lower its ceiling.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia combines a 9-1 FBS record, a 23.9-point margin and wins over Alabama, Oklahoma, Florida, Ole Miss and Missouri, with only a narrow loss to Auburn.
rationales.Utah: Utah is 11-0 overall and 10-0 against FBS teams, with no losses, five road or neutral wins and a 40-39 road win over Arizona.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame is 10-1 with a 25.3-point margin, a neutral-site win over Wisconsin and a home win over Miami, offset only by the road loss to BYU.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, Ole Miss, Missouri and LSU, plus a neutral loss to Oklahoma that keeps it just below the top three.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana's 8-2 record, 13.6-point margin and road wins over Nebraska and Michigan support a top-five case, despite a close home loss to Ohio State.
rationales.Ohio State: Ohio State has a 14.7-point margin and quality wins over Iowa and Indiana, but losses to Texas, USC and Oregon justify placing it sixth.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 9-1 with an 18.1-point margin and wins over Clemson, Stanford and Florida State, with its only loss coming at Notre Dame.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee is 8-2 with a 13.8-point margin, a home win over Alabama and a 27-13 victory over LSU, while its Texas loss occurred at home.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon's 7-3 record includes wins over Ohio State, USC, Michigan and Michigan State, giving it the strongest Big Ten case after Indiana.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with a 16.5-point margin, eight wins over FBS teams and a road upset of Oregon, plus convincing wins over Wisconsin and Michigan State.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 10-1 overall and 9-1 against FBS teams, with zero one-score losses and wins over Houston, Arizona, Oklahoma State and Oregon State.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 9-1 with a 23.3-point margin, no one-score losses and six road or neutral wins, including a 49-7 road win over SMU.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia's 10-1 body of work includes road wins over Alabama, Ole Miss and South Carolina plus a neutral-site rout of Florida, with the lone blemish a one-score home loss to Auburn.
rationales.Utah: Utah is 11-0 with wins over BYU, Houston, Arizona, Iowa State and TCU, and I note honestly that the packet shows no losses to weigh against.
rationales.Miami: Miami's only loss is a competitive road game at Notre Dame, and wins over Wake Forest, Clemson and Florida State anchor an otherwise clean 10-1 resume.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's lone defeat came by four at BYU, while home wins over Miami and SMU and a neutral win over Wisconsin support a top-four case despite some uncertainty about margin quality.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 10-1 with its only loss a road stumble at Cincinnati, and wins over Houston, Arizona, Arizona State and Oklahoma State give it the Big 12's strongest full resume alongside Utah.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest is 10-1 with six road or neutral wins, including a 49-7 rout of SMU and a road win over Louisville, though its schedule strength is the softest among the one-loss teams.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, Ole Miss, Missouri and LSU, and both losses were one-score games to Oklahoma and Florida.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's two losses are one-score games to Georgia and Tennessee, offset by wins over LSU, Florida State, Texas A&M, South Carolina and Vanderbilt.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee's 9-2 mark includes a home win over Alabama and wins at Georgia Tech, Arkansas and Texas A&M, with narrow losses to Texas and South Carolina.
rationales.BYU: BYU's 9-2 resume features a home win over Notre Dame plus wins over Arizona, Iowa State and Kansas State, tempered by losses to Utah and UCF.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana is 9-2 with a home win over USC and road wins at Michigan and Nebraska, and both losses — Ohio State and Washington — were by a combined five points.
rationales.Iowa: Iowa is 9-2 with road wins at Michigan, Washington, Illinois and Northwestern, and its only losses came to Ohio State and a one-point game at Minnesota.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia owns the best collection of direct results, beating Alabama on the road, Oklahoma, Ole Miss, Missouri, Florida and South Carolina; the lone Auburn loss is outweighed by that stacked head-to-head ledger.
rationales.Utah: Utah is unbeaten and its direct wins over BYU, Houston and Arizona carry the day among comparable resumes, with the Arizona road escape the tiebreak over BYU's loss.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's road loss at BYU is close, but its head-to-head home win over Miami plus a dominant 10-1 FBS mark edges the Hurricanes in a near-equal resume.
rationales.Miami: Miami's only loss is the direct game at Notre Dame, so despite strong wins at Wake Forest and Clemson the Hurricanes sit behind the Irish and ahead of Texas.
rationales.Texas: Texas beat Ohio State, Tennessee, Ole Miss, Missouri and LSU, but the head-to-head neutral loss to Oklahoma and home loss to Florida cap the Longhorns below Miami.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech is 9-1 in FBS with direct wins over Houston and Arizona, giving the Red Raiders the head-to-head edge over Alabama's two-loss SEC profile.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's wins over Kentucky, South Carolina and LSU are solid, but the direct losses to Georgia and Tennessee outweigh the broader SEC schedule strength.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee beat Alabama head-to-head and owns wins over LSU and Auburn, but the direct home loss to Texas and road loss at South Carolina keep the Vols behind the Tide.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest's only loss is the direct game to Miami, but its road win at Louisville and blowout wins over SMU, NC State and Georgia Tech make a strong 10-1 case.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA is 10-1 with the decisive road head-to-head win at Oregon and a narrow loss at Michigan; the direct result over the Ducks drives this placement.
rationales.BYU: BYU beat Notre Dame and Arizona head-to-head but the road loss at Utah and the UCF defeat leave the Cougars behind the Utes among Big 12 contenders.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana's home loss to Ohio State is close, but the head-to-head win over USC and road wins at Nebraska and Michigan support a top-12 case.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia passes every visual test with a +23.9 FBS scoring margin and emphatic road blowouts over Alabama, Ole Miss, and South Carolina.
rationales.Utah: Utah remains unblemished at 11-0, pairing a smothering defense with gutty ranked victories over BYU, Arizona, and Houston.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame looks the part of a complete titan, boasting a +25.3 margin and an imposing 31-24 victory over Miami.
rationales.Miami: Miami has steamrolled competition with an explosive offense and four road wins, their only blemish coming in a hard-fought contest in South Bend.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech passes the eye test with dynamic offensive firepower, a 10-1 record, and decisive head-to-head triumphs over Arizona and Houston.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA features an overpowering defense allowing them to control games cleanly, underscored by a pivotal road victory over Oregon.
rationales.Texas: Texas possesses exceptional raw speed and big wins over Tennessee and Ohio State, though minor execution lapses led to two tight setbacks.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest looks like a well-oiled machine, destroying ACC competition by an average margin of 23.3 points per game.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama controls games at the line of scrimmage, though a pair of tough SEC road tests cracked their armor.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee displays a lethal offense and dominant defensive front, highlighted by a commanding 26-10 win over Alabama.
rationales.BYU: BYU looks tough and physical in every phase, holding a marquee victory over Notre Dame while losing only to unbeaten Utah and UCF.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana showcases a disciplined, stingy team identity that dismantled Rutgers and USC, with their only losses coming in one-score dogfights.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia's margins of 27-8 at a neutral site over Florida, 42-7 at Ole Miss, and 48-21 over Missouri show dominance, with the lone loss a 24-27 home defeat to Auburn.
rationales.Miami: Miami has won 9 of 10 with a 24-point average margin and a 31-24 home win over Notre Dame, the only ranked-opponent loss on the packet's list.
rationales.Utah: Utah is unbeaten, and its close 40-39 win at Arizona and 28-20 win over BYU show how it closes out tight games.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's 10-1 record includes a 31-24 home loss to Miami, but a 58-7 Stanford win and a 41-7 win over Boston College show strong margins.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's 17-20 home loss to Georgia is its only blemish against a strong opponent, but wins over Florida State 50-36 and LSU 31-13 show strength.
rationales.Texas: Texas has four one-score wins against a schedule that includes Ohio State, Ole Miss, and LSU, but losses to Florida and Oklahoma came by three points.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee's 26-10 home win over Alabama and 34-6 win over Kentucky show the offensive punch, offset by a 24-27 home loss to South Carolina.
rationales.Ohio State: Ohio State has big early wins, but close losses to Oregon 28-41 and USC 18-30 and a one-score home loss to Indiana temper its profile.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana won 13 of its games by a 13.6 average margin, beating Ohio State 19-15 on the road while losing to Washington 24-27.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech won 9 of 10, including road wins at Oklahoma State 52-27 and Arizona State 53-25, and a home win over Arizona 34-26.
rationales.Iowa: Iowa won at Michigan 20-19 and beat Washington 41-24 on the road, but a 14-31 home loss to Ohio State and a 10-13 loss to Minnesota hurt.
rationales.BYU: BYU has a home win over Notre Dame 28-24 and Arizona 28-17 but lost 20-28 at Utah and 31-39 at UCF.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia stays atop the AP order at 9-1, with wins over Alabama, Oklahoma, Florida, Ole Miss and Missouri offsetting only the home loss to Auburn.
rationales.Utah: Undefeated Utah retains second on its 10-0 FBS record and wins over BYU, Arizona and Houston, including the decisive late-season head-to-head results.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame remains third after beating Miami and SMU convincingly, though BYU's earlier win over the Irish keeps its case from being spotless.
rationales.Miami: Miami's 9-1 record and wins over Wake Forest, Clemson and Florida State support fourth, while Notre Dame's head-to-head win is its lone defeat.
rationales.Texas: Texas keeps fifth after a strong 9-2 slate, with wins over Ohio State, Tennessee, Ole Miss and Missouri and a narrow loss to Oklahoma and Florida.
rationales.Oregon: Oregon rises from AP 14 after beating Ohio State and Michigan on the road; its 7-3 record and losses to UCLA, Illinois and Oklahoma State temper the move.
rationales.Indiana: Indiana's 8-2 mark includes wins over USC, Michigan and Nebraska; its late loss to Washington and home defeat by Ohio State hold it below the top six.
rationales.Texas Tech: Texas Tech stays in the upper tier at 9-1, with wins over Houston, Arizona and Oklahoma State, but its loss to Cincinnati and less imposing schedule keep it outside the top seven.
rationales.Tennessee: Tennessee's wins over Alabama and LSU bolster its 8-2 resume, while the Texas and South Carolina losses prevent a larger rise.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama's 8-2 record and wins over LSU, Texas A&M and Florida State remain impressive, but losses to Georgia and Tennessee keep it behind the stronger one-loss teams.
rationales.UCLA: UCLA's 10-1 record and road win over Oregon are excellent, but its schedule strength and narrow loss at Michigan leave it just outside the top ten.
rationales.Wake Forest: Wake Forest's 9-1 record and broad road success stand out, but the home loss to Miami and softer schedule context place it behind UCLA.

rationales.Georgia: Georgia stays No. 1: 10-1 with the lone blemish a one-point Auburn loss, plus wins over Alabama, Oklahoma, Ole Miss, Missouri and Florida by a 23.9 average margin.
rationales.Utah: Utah is 11-0 with five road/neutral wins, beating BYU, Houston, Arizona, Iowa State and TCU without a loss all season.
rationales.Notre Dame: Notre Dame's only loss is a one-score road game at BYU, and it avenged nothing needed by beating Miami and routing SMU, Stanford, Navy and Boston College.
rationales.Miami: Miami is 10-1 with the sole loss a one-point road defeat at Notre Dame, including wins over Wake Forest, Clemson, Florida State and Pittsburgh.
rationales.Texas: Texas is 9-2 with two one-score losses (Oklahoma, Florida) but elite wins over Ohio State, LSU, Ole Miss, Missouri and Tennessee.
rationales.Alabama: Alabama is 9-2 with two losses to the SEC's top two (Georgia, Tennessee) and a resume featuring LSU, Florida State, Texas A&M and South Carolina wins.
